correctness.rationale: The exact clique evolution, tensorized probability matrices, integer-frequency Cesaro integral, and mutually orthogonal tensor-sector spectral resolution yield all eigenvalues and multiplicities. Nonnegative Laurent weights prove the signed-balance iff; a binary singleton gives the only needed necessity for full positivity; the three-factor balance count proves the sharp abs(m-n)=2 rank law. Exact 9218-entry rational replay corroborates but does not prove the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The full eigenvalue support formula for an infinite mixed Hamming product class and the exact rank jump when abs(m-n)=2 expose a natural transport resonance absent from one-factor ranks. This classification predicts which tensor modes survive dephasing for arbitrary products, and its first genuine heterogeneous resonance restores (m-1)(n-1) additional dimensions, e.g. eight on K2 square K3 square K5.
